Part 1 高频 事件 EVENTS

Morning time

早晨

⚠️ AI 范例，仅供学习 — IELTS 口语全程独立完成，背诵照搬 AI 答案会被考官识别为背稿。

问题与答案

Q1Do you like getting up early in the morning?

Not at all, to be honest. I'm definitely not a morning person, and I struggle to get out of bed before ten on most days. If I have to wake up early, I feel groggy for hours afterwards.

一点都不喜欢早起，不是晨型人，早起了会昏昏沉沉一上午。

Q2What do you usually do in the morning?

Well, I tend to stay in bed for a while, scrolling through my phone until I finally get up. After that, I grab a quick breakfast, usually something simple like porridge or bread, and then start my day.

早上一般赖床刷会儿手机，然后随便吃点粥或面包就开始一天。

Q3What did you do in the morning when you were little? Why?

As a kid, my mornings were totally different, my mum would call me up, I'd lie in bed for a bit, eat breakfast, and then head off to school. I remember the walk to school pretty clearly, actually.

小时候早上被妈妈叫醒，赖会儿床、吃早饭再走去上学，那段上学路记忆很深。

Q4Are there any differences between what you do in the morning now and what you did in the past?

Yeah, the biggest difference is my wake-up time. I used to get up early for school, but now I sleep in much later, especially when I have no classes. Honestly, the lazy mornings are a real luxury.

最大区别是起床时间，以前上学得起早，现在没课就睡懒觉，赖床成了享受。

Q5Do you spend your mornings doing the same things on both weekends and weekdays? Why?

Pretty much, yeah. I get up earlier on weekdays for classes and sleep in on weekends, but the routine after waking is the same, breakfast, phone, then getting on with the day. Only the start time really changes.

差不多一样，工作日早起上课、周末睡懒觉，但起床后的流程都一样，只是开始时间不同。
